task.text: Write 2000 words about the reasons why marriages fail after the age of 60

attempts.high: I'm putting together a 2000-word piece exploring why marriages fall apart after 60, and honestly I want you to take the lead on this one. Pick the angle, decide what reasons matter most, structure it however lands best, find your own throughline — could be reflective, could be punchy, your call. Just make it something worth reading. Roughly 2000 words.
attempts.low: Write 2000 words on why marriages fail after age 60, covering exactly these five reasons in this order, with roughly 400 words each: (1) retirement and loss of shared routine, (2) empty nest after children leave, (3) divergent health and caregiving burdens, (4) financial stress in later life, (5) growing apart over decades. Use these five as section headers, don't add other reasons, and don't include an intro or conclusion beyond the five sections.
reasons: leakage on non-target axis 'warmth': HIGH=4, LOW=2 (differ by 2, max allowed 1). Equalize this dimension across the two versions.
